name: 02093 · Wrentham, MA
findings: ZIP 02093 (Wrentham) has 48 nonprofit organizations. 22 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 16 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 02093 (Wrentham) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 02093 (Wrentham) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).
